head: 4772071bf90c00494e3e009c0aa1b25249edf069
cause: All ten exact Forge cases executed: seven passed and three projected-type fixtures stopped at their precondition. The fixture compared the complete projected types string set to only card-type names, but the projection also retained Human and Wizard subtype strings. The three assertions failed before the unchanged counter-result assertions. The dependency correction compiled successfully. No engine or card behavior change is justified by this result.
correction: Intersect projected getTypes with the SDK CardType enum names and still assert exact equality to the requested card-type set. Preserve the printed-creature precondition, target acceptance, and independent expected +1/+1 and loyalty counter outcomes in all three cases.
